verses.text: of David. Unto You, O YHWH, I lift up my soul.

segments.text: of David. Unto You, O YHWH, I lift up my soul.

verses.text: My God, in You I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies rejoice over me.

segments.text: My God, in You I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies rejoice over me.

verses.text: Indeed, all those waiting on You will not be put to shame; those who act treacherously without cause will be ashamed.

segments.text: Indeed, all those waiting on You will not be put to shame; those who act treacherously without cause will be ashamed.

verses.text: May You show me Your ways, O YHWH; may You teach me Your paths.

segments.text: May You show me Your ways, O YHWH; may You teach me Your paths.

verses.text: Make me to walk in Your truth and teach me, for You [are] the God of my salvation; on You I wait all the day.

segments.text: Make me to walk in Your truth and teach me, for You [are] the God of my salvation; on You I wait all the day.

verses.text: Remember Your mercies, O YHWH, and Your loving devotion, for they [are] from of old.

segments.text: Remember Your mercies, O YHWH, and Your loving devotion, for they [are] from of old.

verses.text: May You not remember the sins of my youth, and my transgressions; according to Your loving devotion, may You remember me, for the sake of Your goodness, O YHWH.

segments.text: May You not remember the sins of my youth, and my transgressions; according to Your loving devotion, may You remember me, for the sake of Your goodness, O YHWH.

verses.text: Good and upright [is] YHWH; upon thus, He directs sinful ones in the way.

segments.text: Good and upright [is] YHWH; upon thus, He directs sinful ones in the way.

verses.text: He guides the humble ones in justice, and He teaches the humble ones His way.

segments.text: He guides the humble ones in justice, and He teaches the humble ones His way.

verses.text: All the paths of YHWH [are] loving devotion and truth, to those keeping His covenant and His decrees.

segments.text: All the paths of YHWH [are] loving devotion and truth, to those keeping His covenant and His decrees.

verses.text: And for the sake of Your name, O YHWH, may You pardon my iniquity, though it [is] great.

segments.text: And for the sake of Your name, O YHWH, may You pardon my iniquity, though it [is] great.

verses.text: Who [is] this man, the one fearing YHWH? He will direct him in the way he must choose.

segments.text: Who [is] this man, the one fearing YHWH? He will direct him in the way he must choose.

verses.text: His soul shall dwell in goodness, and his seed shall possess the land.

segments.text: His soul shall dwell in goodness, and his seed shall possess the land.

verses.text: The counsel of YHWH [is] with those fearing Him, and He makes known to them His covenant.

segments.text: The counsel of YHWH [is] with those fearing Him, and He makes known to them His covenant.

verses.text: My eyes [are] continually toward YHWH, for He brings out my feet from a net.

segments.text: My eyes [are] continually toward YHWH, for He brings out my feet from a net.

verses.text: May You turn to me and show favor to me, for I [am] lonely and afflicted.

segments.text: May You turn to me and show favor to me, for I [am] lonely and afflicted.

verses.text: The troubles of my heart have enlarged; may You bring me out from my distress.

segments.text: The troubles of my heart have enlarged; may You bring me out from my distress.

verses.text: Look on my affliction and my trouble, and lift all my sins.

segments.text: Look on my affliction and my trouble, and lift all my sins.

verses.text: See my enemies!—For they are many, and with violent hatred they hate me.

segments.text: See my enemies!—For they are many, and with violent hatred they hate me.

verses.text: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.

segments.text: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.

verses.text: May integrity and uprightness keep me, for I wait for You.

segments.text: May integrity and uprightness keep me, for I wait for You.

verses.text: May You redeem Israel, O God, from all his distress.

segments.text: May You redeem Israel, O God, from all his distress.
